data.value:
Open as signs in to this site as any of its users, without a password.
Each sign in runs the apps' on_login and on_session_creation hooks, as a real login does: it sets last_login, adds an Activity Log entry, mails the System Managers for Administrator and may create an ERPNext Customer or Supplier for a Website User. It may end that user's oldest session.
